name: asana
description: Reads 106 bounded source-bound direct operations and 12 declared Asana ETL streams, and executes 94 approval-gated reverse-ETL actions. The pinned OpenAPI ledger accounts for every official operation as an executable covered_by route, an exact named foundation gap, or the one not-applicable generic batch wrapper.

risk.read: external Asana API reads use fixed declared streams or bounded source-bound operations; no raw provider query/path passthrough
risk.write: external mutations require named reverse-ETL actions, schemas, previews, explicit approval, and typed destructive confirmation when destructive/admin
risk.approval: all write execution follows plan -> preview -> explicit approval -> execute; destructive actions also require confirm: destructive
